target: roadside fruit stands and farm stands on Oahu (fixed locations, posted days)

rows.name: North Shore Farm Stand (Āina Sustainability Growers of Hawaii)
rows.address: 66-249 Kamehameha Hwy Unit B, Haleiwa, HI 96712
rows.schedule_text: The farm's own site says the stand is open to the public Wednesdays and Thursdays, 12 p.m. to 6 p.m. A Haleʻiwa Town guide lists different hours (Wed–Fri 9 a.m.–3 p.m., Sat 8:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.), so verify before listing.
rows.organizer: Āina Sustainability Growers of Hawaii LLC (owner and farmer Luis Dasilveira)
rows.description: Farm stand in Haleʻiwa town selling fresh produce and products grown and made in Moku o Waialua.
rows.source_label: Farm's own website; address and alternate hours from haleiwatown.com market guide
rows.notes: The farm's page gives Wed/Thu 12–6 but carries no date. The street address and the conflicting hours come from haleiwatown.com, which calls it the ĀINA Farm Stand. I matched it to this website by name and town. Confirm the schedule with the farm.

rows.name: Kualoa Coconut Man
rows.neighborhood: Waikāne / Kahaluʻu (sources differ; some say Kāneʻohe)
rows.description: Roadside stand on Kamehameha Highway that cracks fresh coconuts to order and sells fruit such as bananas and papaya.
rows.notes: I found no website or social page for the stand. The same hours appear on directory listings. Sources give the address as a range and disagree on the town name. Check on-site before listing because hours may shift with weather.

rows.name: Haleiwa Fruit Shack
rows.schedule_text: Usually open daily, 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. The stand's own TikTok says it is open 7 days a week 'most of the time'. A TikTok post also says it sells at the KCC Farmers Market on Saturdays, 7:30–11:15 a.m.
rows.description: Roadside fruit shack selling fruit platters, fresh-pressed sugarcane juice and cold coconuts.
rows.source_label: Business Facebook page; hours from nateeatshawaii.com listing and the business's TikTok (@thehaleiwafruitshack)
rows.notes: No Instagram handle was confirmed, so it is null. The TikTok handle is @thehaleiwafruitshack. The address is the same on the Facebook page and several listings, but one TikTok caption shows a different number (62-540), so verify. Hours may vary day to day.

rows.name: Kahuku Land Farms Stand
rows.neighborhood: Kahuku (across from Kawela Bay, near Turtle Bay Resort)
rows.description: Roadside stands selling local pineapple, coconut, sugarcane, mango and banana bread. The 2026 North Shore guide lists the address and says cash is preferred.
rows.source_label: Wanderlustyle North Shore eating guide (2026), with older descriptions from Lonely Planet and a YAH Global directory
rows.notes: No posted days or hours were found. This is a cluster of stands across from Kawela Bay and may overlap with stands already in the directory (e.g., Chue's Farm Fruit Stand). Check for duplicates before adding. A Hawaiʻi Life guide's 9–5 daily hours appear to refer to Kahuku Farms, so I did not use them.

rows.name: Waiahole Farm
rows.description: Windward-side stand reported to sell fresh-cut fruit, juices and seasonal tropical fruit.
rows.notes: Only a single social mention was found. There is no address, hours or official handle, and I could not tie it to a specific business page. Needs a first-party source before it goes in the directory.
